question: What are the estimated gross market borrowings and net market borrowings from dated securities for the Union Budget 2026–27?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹17.2 lakh crore and ₹11.7 lakh crore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2026-27 estimates gross market borrowings at ₹17.2 lakh crore and net market borrowings from dated securities at ₹11.7 lakh crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Gross market borrowings for BE 2026-27 are estimated at ₹17.2 lakh crore.**
 
• Net market borrowings from dated securities are projected at ₹11.7 lakh crore.
 
• Gross borrowings include fresh borrowings as well as repayments of past debt.
 
• Net market borrowings reflect the actual addition to the government’s debt stock.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Gross Market Borrowings__

 __
 
• Gross market borrowings refer to the total funds raised by the government from the market in a financial year.
 
• They include borrowings for meeting fiscal deficit as well as refinancing maturing debt.
 
 
 
• Net Market Borrowings__
 __
 
• Net market borrowings represent fresh borrowing after adjusting for repayments.
 
• They indicate the net increase in government liabilities.
 
 
 
• Dated Securities__
 __
 
• Dated securities are government bonds with a fixed maturity period.
 
• They form the largest component of market borrowing by the central government.
 
 
 
• Budget Estimates (BE)__
 
 
• Budget Estimates present projected fiscal figures for the upcoming financial year.
 
• They guide borrowing plans and debt management strategy.
